name: Dominican Republic
description: The Dominican Republic from the Taíno to the first Spanish city of the Americas, independence from Haiti, Trujillo and baseball.

checkpoints.name: Hispaniola
checkpoints.note: The Taíno lived on the island when Columbus came. Santo Domingo was the first Spanish city of the Americas. Spain, France and Haiti ruled in turn.

checkpoints.name: The republic
checkpoints.note: Independence from Haiti came in 1844. Spain returned for a time, and the United States occupied the country from 1916 to 1924.

checkpoints.name: Trujillo and after
checkpoints.note: Trujillo ruled harshly until 1961. Democracy grew slowly, and the country became known for baseball and merengue.
